scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: RAGFlip: Measuring Query-Level Negative Flips in Retriever Upgrades
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.07266v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Retriever upgrades are typically evaluated using aggregate metrics, which can hide regressions on queries the previous retriever already served correctly. We study these regressions as negative flips: queries for which BM25 retrieves a judged relevant passage and the replacement does not. We evaluate BGE-large, E5-large-v2, and SPLADE on three BEIR collections: Natural Questions, HotpotQA, and FiQA, across five retrieval depths. All replacements improve overall retrieval coverage. Negative flips occur in every setting and vary substantially by corpus, retriever, and depth. At k=1, 8.6-37.5% of BM25 successes are lost across the evaluated settings. Negative-flip rates are lower in the larger-depth settings, where the BM25-supported cohort is defined separately at each depth. These rates use the any-relevant support label. On HotpotQA at k=10, requiring every positive qrel passage raises the negative-flip rate to 12.3-17.3%. Simple fixed-b
papers.summary: 论文检查检索器升级后被总体均值掩盖的查询退化，在三个 BEIR 集合上比较 BGE、E5 与 SPLADE。即使总体覆盖率提高，k=1 时仍丢失 BM25 原本成功查询的 8.6%–37.5%；固定预算融合 BM25 可减少这种负向翻转。
papers.key_insight: 社区短文本搜索升级应同时观察总体 nDCG 和旧检索器成功查询的保留率，尤其关注词面精确匹配与长尾表达。可把查询级退化测试加入发布门槛，并在相同候选预算下比较词法与向量融合；论文中的问答退化检查规模有限，不能直接推断社区 CTR 收益。

papers.title: Learning to Retrieve via Reinforcement Learning in Embedding Space
papers.authors: Qi Liu, Fengming Liang, Yiqun Chen, Erhan Zhang, Jiaxin Mao
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.07731v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Dense retrieval models are typically trained with contrastive objectives that learn effective representations but do not directly optimize retrieval metrics or downstream task performance. To address this problem, we introduce RELER (REinforcement LEarning for Retrieval), a reinforcement learning framework that enables existing embedding models to learn to retrieve directly in embedding space and align to task-specific rewards. We train RELER by sampling unit-length query and document embedding actions from von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distributions centered on normalized encoder outputs, scoring the resulting retrieval or downstream outcomes as rewards, and updating the encoder with REINFORCE using a leave-one-out baseline (RLOO). As exploration in the high-dimensional embedding space is prone to sampling noise, we further propose conditional-mean projection (CMP), which projects each sampled embedding onto the low-dimensional subspace spanne
papers.summary: RELER 在单位球面的向量空间采样，通过检索奖励和 RLOO 更新编码器，并用条件均值投影降低梯度噪声。BRIGHT 原始查询上，BGE-M3 的 nDCG@10 从 InfoNCE 的 12.63 升至 14.49；Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 从 22.64 升至 23.38。
papers.key_insight: 对 UGC 搜索，可探索将编码器后训练直接对齐相关性奖励，而非仅依赖对比损失；其推理仍是确定性向量检索。优先在固定文档索引下适配查询编码器，降低重建成本，同时按主题检查收益分布；平均提升不代表每个领域都改善，奖励构造与训练候选访问也影响比较结果。

papers.title: UNREAL: Unifying Retrieval and Long-Context with a Single Model
papers.authors: Edan Kinderman, Elad Hoffer, Yochai Blau, Brian Chmiel, Ron Banner, Daniel Soudry, Boris Ginsburg
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.08463v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Long-context inference and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) handle evidence selection at vastly different scales, from a single long prompt to an entire corpus. We ask whether a single model-internal mechanism can select evidence across this range. We introduce UNifying REtrieval And Long-Context with a Single Model (UNREAL), a model-native evidence selection framework to span corpus retrieval and long-context inference. UNREAL encodes chunks and derives retrieval queries directly from the frozen LLM's internal representations. It adds fewer than 500K trainable parameters and leaves the backbone unchanged. On a 3B-token, 21M-chunk Wikipedia index, all four dense and hybrid UNREAL backbones outperform state-of-the-art retriever-reranker systems. The best model raises recall from 49.1% to 73.2% on HotpotQA, from 31.7% to 60.1% on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and from 8.8% to 14.4% on MuSiQue. Applied to long-context tasks, the same selection mec
papers.summary: UNREAL 从冻结语言模型内部表征构建查询和文档向量，用少于 50 万新增参数统一语料检索与长上下文证据选择。在 2100 万块的索引上，最佳模型将 HotpotQA 召回率从 49.1% 提升至 73.2%，2WikiMultiHopQA 从 31.7% 提升至 60.1%。
papers.key_insight: 检索表征与读者表征对齐，为社区帖子和关联问答的证据选择提供了新方向。可先在多证据查询离线验证，再评估索引构建、向量存储与首 token 时延；新增可训练参数少并不意味着底座推理便宜。论文的多跳问答收益需要通过社区相关性标注验证，不能直接等同于 CTR 提升。

papers.title: Tree Navigation Without LLM Summaries: A Matched-Cost Study of Hierarchical Retrieval for Long-Document QA
papers.authors: Priyank Jayraj, Poonam Goyal, Navneet Goyal
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.06902v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation grounds language models in external context, but for long documents flat top-$k$ retrieval can cluster on a single region and miss complementary evidence. RAPTOR-style summary trees address this by recursively clustering chunks and using a language model to summarize each cluster at indexing time, then ranking summary nodes alongside raw chunks at query time. We show the main benefit of summary trees in long-document QA can come from navigation rather than the generated summary content. We introduce NavTree, a leaves-only retriever that builds a deterministic balanced segment tree over chunks (zero language-model calls at indexing) and uses the tree purely as a navigation scaffold: a hybrid lexical-and-dense frontier walk, anchored on top retrieved leaves, descends from the root and emits only leaf chunks to the reader. On a matched-cost evaluation against flat retrievers and an extractive re-implementati
papers.summary: NavTree 用确定性平衡树组织文档片段，结合词法与稠密信号导航，只向读者输出叶子文本，不在建索引时调用语言模型。在 1024 token 预算下，QuALITY 准确率为 72.5%，RAPTOR 抽取式复现为 68.1%；QASPER token F1 为 0.401。
papers.key_insight: 对社区长帖与问答串，可借鉴保留原始证据、用结构辅助召回的设计，先减少摘要生成的索引成本。应以相同读者和上下文预算比较平坦混合检索与树导航；论文显示其与最强平坦基线接近，不能只拿较弱层次模型作比较。纯短帖未必需要树结构，需按文档长度分层验证。

papers.title: A Study of Prior Case Retrieval Using Lexical, Semantic, and Rhetorical Role Information in Indian Legal Documents
papers.authors: Sayed Ayaan Ahmed Sha, Sangeetha Sivanesan, Anand Kumar Madasamy, Navya Binu, Aniket Mani, Rishu Kumar
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.07437v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: For retrieving prior cases in Indian legal judgments, the problem involves distinguishing relevant legal facts from mere lexical similarities because a prior case that shares a statute with the query judgment is not necessarily relevant. In this paper, we describe an empirical evaluation of three consecutive designs of retrieval systems for the IL PCR(Indian Legal Prior Case Retrieval) task. We demonstrate that the combination of the rhetorical roles (Fact, Ratio Of The Decision, Precedent, Argument, Statute) is better than either using individual roles or performing full text retrieval, that statute similarity is not discriminative, and that a legal entailment reranker with training data produced by an LLM is much worse in terms of official evaluation than its internal validation score. Two rankers, with excellent internal MRR up to 0.97, performed poorly in terms of official evaluation (MRR as low as 0.14). Thus, we propose a new desig
papers.summary: 论文比较印度法律先例检索的词法、语义与修辞角色组合，揭示伪标签重排的验证偏差：内部 MRR 可达 0.97，正式评测却低至 0.14。改用查询互斥划分和冻结验证融合后，四阶段系统达到 MRR 0.6081、nDCG@10 0.4187。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索同样要防止同一查询及近重复帖子跨训练与验证集泄漏，尤其是用大模型生成相关性标签时。可借鉴按查询隔离数据、验证集固定融合权重的流程，并检查话题标签相同但内容不相关的负样本。法律修辞角色本身不能直接移植到短帖，适合迁移的是评测和数据划分方法。

papers.title: Do We Still Need Gazetteers in the Era of LLMs? Chaining Retrieval with a Spatial Neuro-Symbolic Index
papers.authors: Alexis Horde-Vo, Matt Duckham, Estrid He
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.05028v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Geographic information retrieval (GeoIR) tasks require systems to interpret ambiguous toponyms for downstream applications. Traditionally, toponym resolution relies on gazetteers to provide an explicit index of place entities and spatial relationships. Recently, gazetteer-free approaches seek to reduce dependence on handcrafted searches: dense retrieval utilizes text encoders to capture rich context, moving beyond the limitations of lexical search. However, text encoders implicitly assume that learned representations can function as reliable spatial-semantic indexes. In this paper, we evaluate this assumption through a spatial-semantic indexing setup: given a contextualized toponym mention, we retrieve the corresponding gazetteer entity represented by text derived from a gazetteer knowledge graph. We benchmark five frozen text encoders under two retrieval strategies: brute-force nearest-neighbor retrieval over entity representations,
papers.summary: 论文以五种冻结文本编码器比较无约束向量召回与地名层次约束束搜索，检查语义向量是否保存空间关系。在 GeoView 的 GV 数据上，BGE 的覆盖准确率由 0.26 升至 0.84；但细粒度定位和平均距离误差并未得到一致改善。
papers.key_insight: 对含地点的社区搜索，应把行政层次和地理约束作为显式召回信号，避免仅靠文本相似度造成跨地区误召回。需要分别测量国家或区域覆盖与具体地点误差；粗粒度改善不能代表精确定位提升。可将地名索引与语义召回组合，并用本地简称、同名地点和用户上下文验证。

papers.title: DBRAG: Multi-Table Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Complex Database Queries
papers.authors: Prince Larbi Ampofo, Ryoji Kubo, Djellel Difallah
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.07622v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recent advancements in large language models have introduced new capabilities for reasoning over structured data, particularly through program-aided tools that can analyze tables. However, many existing methods address single-table scenarios or assume that the relevant tables are already provided. In practice, users often issue complex data exploration queries over entire databases, where relevant information may be distributed across multiple relations. In this work, we introduce DBRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework tailored for multi-table question answering. DBRAG first retrieves candidate tables using an offline table index, enriches their summaries with query-relevant rows, and uses an LLM to rerank the candidates. A program-aided reasoner then selects the required tables and executes operations over their full contents, keeping the initial prompt context compact. Experiments on the Spider, GeoQuery, and ATIS datasets u
papers.summary: DBRAG 先粗召回数据库表，再把查询相关行补入表摘要进行语言模型重排，最后执行多表计算。Spider 上 Recall@5 从粗排的 89.5% 提升至 95.8%，高于 JAR 粗排融合的 93.0%；仅用表名和 schema 的版本为 83.7%。
papers.key_insight: 可借鉴查询相关局部内容增强候选表示的思路，让社区帖子摘要保留对当前 query 有用的片段，再进入重排。论文主要处理结构化多表问答，与短文本帖子存在明显差异，因此适合作为技术参考。其粗排 50 表、精排 5 表的预算需在真实候选规模与延迟约束下重新选择。
